title: The stadiums' trainers: res/field/stadium/trainers.json
description: ARCID_SCRCMD_STADIUM (a/2/0/6), a StadiumTrainerEntry per trainer (include/field/stadium_script.h), which the stadium's script commands load and set NPCs up from (scrcmd_stadium.c). tools/data/stadium_data.py packs it.

trainers.description: The trainers, always 0x84, as FindStadiumTrainerIndex searches that many and Scrcmd_Stadium_StadiumResetTrainerFlags clears their battle flags; Scrcmd_Stadium_StadiumSetupActorsTriple names them by their place

unk00.description: The first key that FindStadiumTrainerIndex matches the script's first argument to

unk02.description: The second key, which it matches the script's last argument to

model.description: The NPC's model, an OBJ_CODE_* constant, which only Scrcmd_Stadium_StadiumSetupActorsTriple sets

trainer.description: The trainer, a constant of generated/trainers.txt, whose battle script the NPC gets (GetNormalSCRIDFromTrainerID, and GetPairMember2SCRIDFromTrainerID for the second of a double)
